notes: Recite to me 🎤: recite an Ayah aloud and the app marks any missed or wrong words in red (words only, not Tajweed). If it can’t hear clearly, it says so instead of guessing.
What does it mean? A short explanation of every Ayah (Al-Mukhtasar) in Malayalam, English or Arabic, in lessons and the Quran reader.
Kids mode: brighter colours, bigger text, Noor the friendly star, a sticker for every Ayah memorised, cheerful sounds and gentle break reminders.
Sound effects for correct answers and celebrations (can be turned off in Me).
A new app icon: the gold Rub el Hizb star with an open Mushaf, so it no longer looks like Family Budget.
Listen to 12 world-famous reciters, including two teaching-style recitations for memorising.
Read translations under every Ayah: Saheeh International, Hilali & Khan, Wahiduddin Khan, transliteration and two Malayalam translations.
Pick several goals and translations at once in setup.
A daily goal ring, streak week, levels, 15 badges and a Quran journey map.
Celebrations when you memorise an Ayah.
This Update button: new versions now install from inside the app.
Verified Quran text, 7-step memorisation lessons, spaced revision, challenges and streaks.
